The new repo is [this repository]

This repo should allow anyone to train the models we have trained, but this time we should hone in and create focused groups and a strategy that trains the 1 XG boost model, the fusion head, and then the multiple dino heads in their organized folder. 

VeilGarde has a CLI tool to explore this.

I should be able to clearly see our files organized in a proper subpackage that is meant for training and a subpackage that is meant for inference with each of the files organized into their rightful place and data structures for maximum readability and understanding.

[The research project] did a lot of research in discovering the proper flywheel approach or infinite growth in handling all types of ai generated work. This VeilGarde project is meant to reflect that with another subpackage called Flywheel that is meant for running training regimes on the specialist head network at the end alone.

The subpackage meant for training is meant for the core thesis on the homography perspective warp and all of our research on top that made it more robust.

The subpackage meant for inference brings them all together for the detection tooling and outcome we see today in [the detector].

This is our time to create a clear and cohesive package to involve all of these technologies in 1 solution.

We had also explored robust watermarking, where the hash created from the perspective warp procedure doubles as a signature we can create on an image, generated or real. Create another subpackage called VeilWatermark that just creates the hash of an image directly reusing the residual warp signature from tiles. The watermark works in a way that it is a sectioned off pattern so if the same image is cropped in multiple ways the same signature can be produced from the tiled patterns found in the residual loss of the perspective warp fragility rate that is concatenated at specific sequences.

answers.question: How should VeilGarde's inference package relate to Garde's core API?
answers.answer: Clean break

answers.question: Where does VeilGarde's Flywheel begin?
answers.answer: Include Swift scraper + CLIP router, but we need to implement a new system where image features are stored directly, which may not required NSFW flags, the goal is to not store the images at all, just their features that are required for head creation and/or updating an existing heads.

answers.answer: macOS 26 only

answers.question: Commit policy during the build?
answers.answer: Commit per phase on main

answers.question: The atlas anchors (<datasets>/atlas/anchors) are no longer on the T9 or in the 2026-10-03 cleanup archive. The battery's eight atlas RATCHET groups resolve to no images and score 0 against their floors, so every full-gate promote (a head, the combiner, a calibration) fails, in the Python runner as in VeilGarde's, until they are restored or the work-area spec marks those groups skip_if_empty. Which do you want?
answers.answer: Retire the atlas anchor groups; a new atlas will be built later (amendment-4, item 6).

answers.question: The retrained noiseprint beats the shipped one's held-out AUC (0.955 against 0.942) but reads the adversarial anchor ig_4382a71faeeee1 as a camera (0.578 against 0.429). Keep the shipped net, as VeilGarde does, or retrain against negatives that include photoreal AI with forged capture peaks (the families the atlas cleanup removed)?
answers.answer: Retrain the noiseprint with photoreal forgeries, and add an explorer trail for the noiseprint process (amendment-4, item 7).

answers.question: The photoreal noiseprint passed every adoption rule fixed before it ran (decision-67: anchor 0.386 < 0.5; pooled AUC 0.963 against the shipped net's 0.947; photoreal 0.989 against 0.978) and the full battery with it (command-51: no call changed; HNOyD6zXUAArDeR moves to 0.508, 0.008 above the line). It is staged as candidates/noiseprint-photoreal. Replace the shipped noiseprint with it (a frozen artifact: the combiner's noiseprint weight was set on the shipped net's scores, so a refit of the combiner may follow), or keep it staged?
answers.answer: Was the photoreal noiseprint an important change over the current combiner's noiseprint? I thought we wanted to photoreal due to its importance in the pipeline of the warp into fusion model which is primarily focused on real cameras/hardware detection. Correct me if I am wrong, if not then refit it and replace the current with the photoreal

answers.question: The pruning study (decision-68, command-56, command-54, command-57, command-52) leaves five changes the rules allow and nothing shipped has taken: drop the warp model's four seam features, whose refit moves no more calls than a re-seed; drop fusion's three sharpness inputs, the same; train a scratch fusion head with 400 trees in place of 500; take the art-pair adjudicator out of the combiner, which breaks 19 store calls to fix 10 and kept every battery call; and say the camera-sensor call as two cuts on the raw tile vote, 0.717 and 0.837, which the Platt contract already equals. The rescue, the art and blur heads, the warp model's size and its demosaic, noise and residual features are not candidates. Which, if any, should a retrain take?
answers.answer:
- Keep the seam features for now.
- Keep the fusion head inputs
- Keep the current fusion heads
- remove the art-pair adjucator
- Make the camera-sensor call two cuts on the raw tile vote then

answers.question: The noiseprint does not feed the warp-to-fusion path: it acts only in the combiner, on an image with no capture signature and a base under 0.75, and only to pull it toward real (answer-7 assumed otherwise). The photoreal net is the better camera detector on its own held-out images (AUC 0.963 against 0.947; the forged anchor at 0.386 against 0.429), but in the full detector it changed no call on the battery (command-51) or on 300 census images (command-66), moving scores both ways. Swap it in for the shipped net, or keep the shipped one?
answers.answer: no

answers.question: The 19 warp features split into the residual ten (FR, LV, CV, CM, CC, CR and the four seams) and the raw-tile nine the request lists. What happens with the seven residual features the request does not name: CM, CC, CR and the seams?
answers.answer: Add them to the pool: forward selection may pick any of the sixteen non-trio features.

answers.question: The 438 iPhone originals are final_mixed's iphone pool, so the stem split puts 296 in training and 74 in the test partition. How is the iPhone camera signature measured?
answers.answer: Both designs: per-pool rows on the stem-split test partition, and a second run that leaves the whole iPhone pool out of training and calibration and scores all 438.

answers.question: Which bars decide a feature that moves the needle and the golden combination: 0.005 vote AUC and 2 points on the sensor-call shares, tighter at 0.0025 and 1 point, or looser at 0.01 and 5 points?
answers.answer: 0.005 vote AUC and 2 points, with the seed-control floor for moving the needle.

answers.question: How deep does the fusion test go: the warp score pooled in the fusion head's place on the shipped stack, or also a store re-derivation with a combiner refit on the warp base, several GPU hours?
answers.answer: The bypass on the shipped stack only; the re-derivation and the refit are written up as a follow-on.

answers.question: The redundancy check needs each final_mixed image's noiseprint, DINOv2 and capture beside its cached tiles. The store holds 8,760 of the 12,000 with DINOv2 and capture, and no noiseprint on any. Measure all 12,000 or only the noiseprint of those 8,760?
answers.answer: Only the 8,760 store rows.

answers.question: Expanding the trio could also mean the lens's dormant directional probes, columns 20 to 40, which need a new tile cut and a truncated grid. Include them?
answers.answer: Not in this run: written up as a follow-on with their cost and their geometry.

answers.question: The redundancy verdicts' bars: redundant at a gain of at most 0.005 AUC, complementary when the gain's interval excludes zero and exceeds 0.005, reconstructed at a held-out AUC of at least 0.90; or tighter, or looser?
answers.answer: The owner answered with amendment-18, the condensed model, and named no bar; the proposed 0.005 and 0.90 were fixed when the plan was approved.

answers.question: The result JSON once the warp leaves detection: keep schema v2 with its warp, majority and sensor fields emptied, or a clean break to a schema v3 of VeilGarde's own?
answers.answer: Schema v3, a clean break (Recommended)

answers.question: The noiseprint: keep it as the combiner's camera evidence, or drop it from the detector, the bundle, the store's columns and the trainers?
answers.answer: Drop it entirely (Recommended)

answers.question: Zoom escalation, the render taxonomy and the x-domain gate, none of which runs by default: keep them behind their switches, or remove all three?
answers.answer: Remove all three (Recommended)

answers.question: The bar the retrained fusion head and combiner must clear before they ship: the battery's floors, a census bar, or none?
answers.answer: No bar

answers.question: The golden combination of warp features, or the shipped warp model?
answers.answer: Closed by amendment-21: the warp left detection on 2026-10-21, so no warp model ships and none is chosen; the golden candidate stays in the work area and its code on the 2026-rnd branch.

answers.question: The noiseprint term: keep it, take it out, or decide it with the warp model?
answers.answer: Taken out with everything else of the noiseprint (answer-18).

answers.question: The condensed model: pursue it, or close it?
answers.answer: Closed by amendment-21: detection is the fusion head and the specialist stack; the condensed model's code is on the 2026-rnd branch.

answers.question: The site's data cap: keep 3.5 MB, or restore 3 MB?
answers.answer: Restored to 3 MB: with the warp's, the noiseprint's and the studies' sources gone the data measured 2.28 MB on 2026-10-21, under the old cap (decision-117).

answers.question: The lost calls are generated photoreal images with no capture signature, not iPhone cameras, and DINOv2 cannot separate them even on its own training rows; the warp residual's statistics can. Should a residual signal come back into detection?
answers.answer: Can we explore adding those statistics to the fusion head

answers.question: Where should the residual enter the verdict?
answers.answer: Measure both, keep the better (Recommended)

answers.question: What bar must a candidate clear before it ships, fixed before any number is measured?
answers.answer: Near the warp era (Recommended): the battery PASS with every HARD image right, at least 155 of 200 final_mixed census images right, at least 433 of 438 iPhone originals real

answers.question: Can the study also measure the combiner at reals ×1 and ×2 beside ×3?
answers.answer: Yes, measure ×1 and ×2 (Recommended)

answers.question: Which residual views should the build measure, given that the FR, LV and CV statistics add about +0.016 AUC and a 19-feature tile model +0.033?
answers.answer: The owner asked whether DINOv2 truly misses what covers that AUC (amendment-23); the plan then measured both DINOv2 readings and a bigger booster, without the residual

answers.question: If detection reads the residual again, where should its code live?
answers.answer: Stay in VeilWatermark (Recommended)

decisions.rejected: Garde's v1-v4 bundling with ordered fallback names
decisions.reason: Garde loads only v4; a manifest names one file per role

decisions.chose: A feature shard is written once and never overwritten
decisions.rejected: the Python write_shard, which replaced a same-named shard silently
decisions.reason: a lost shard is lost features whose images no longer exist

decisions.rejected: ImageIO plus an exact EXIF pixel permutation (matched NSImage on sRGB synthetic tests)
decisions.reason: on rotated iPhone JPEGs NSImage renders Display P3 into Generic RGB: the ImageIO path moved the capture peak by up to 50 and flipped a weighted verdict (parity-garde hard list, 2026-10-19); every Swift-trained artifact saw NSImage's pixels

decisions.chose: The detector reads every artifact through a DetectorBundle chosen in the config (shipped by default)
decisions.rejected: Garde's Bundle.module lookups
decisions.reason: the flywheel's battery must judge the live bundle or a candidate exactly as promote would deploy it

decisions.chose: The router is synchronous and split one mechanism per file (CapturePriors, FrameSeam, SemanticChain with ZoomEscalation and PreviewTail)
decisions.rejected: Garde's single async router run
decisions.reason: MLX work is synchronous on one thread anyway; one file per mechanism makes the compounding order readable

decisions.chose: The Playground reads the parity crops and Garde's goldens from Tests/VeilGardeInferenceTests/Fixtures
decisions.rejected: copying them into Playground/Images
decisions.reason: one copy of each golden; the playground checks itself against the same bytes the tests do

decisions.chose: A native CPU gradient-boosting trainer in Swift with XGBoost 3.2's hist arithmetic (Float gradients, Double histograms, Float gains, ties to the lower feature then bin, the smaller-hessian child built and its sibling subtracted)
decisions.rejected: an MLX trainer, or shelling out to Python's xgboost
decisions.reason: histogram building is a data-dependent scatter-add that MLX does not speed up, and the package must train without Python; on integer features it grows xgboost's trees node for node (BoostTrainerTests)

decisions.chose: The default base_score is XGBoost 3.2's: the weighted label mean at scale_pos_weight 1, one Newton step from margin 0 otherwise
decisions.rejected: always the label mean
decisions.reason: measured against xgboost 3.2.0 on four configurations (scratchpad xgb_base.py): the two rules differ once scale_pos_weight is not 1

decisions.chose: The deployed warp shape is optimal_8's recorded settings: 200 trees, depth 8, eta 0.1, subsample 0.8, colsample_bytree 0.8, seed 0
decisions.rejected: sweeping eta over 0.03, 0.05 and 0.1 as the plan proposed
decisions.reason: the research's xgboost_tile32_v2.5_optimal_8.pkl records them in get_params(), so nothing needs to be guessed

decisions.chose: The head split is ported draw for draw: CPython's random.Random (MT19937, init_by_array, getrandbits, randbelow, shuffle) in Swift
decisions.rejected: a hash split in place of the reference's
decisions.reason: the shipped heads were split by random.Random(0).shuffle; matching it lets a retrained head be compared with the shipped one on the same test sources (PythonRandomTests, SplitTests)

decisions.chose: The feature store keeps duplicate ids by default, as the Python FS.read does; dedup is an option
decisions.rejected: dropping later copies of an id, as Phase 2 did
decisions.reason: The seed store holds 68 ids twice and its heads were fitted with both copies; ingest and the flywheel ask for dedup explicitly

decisions.chose: The fusion head's new-generator recall is measured on a 30% holdout that is left out of training
decisions.rejected: the research's v199_warmstart.py, which reported recall on rows it also trained on
decisions.reason: a recall on training rows cannot show a regression; the holdout is StableSplit on the row id, so it is the same rows on every run

decisions.chose: Linear heads, the art-pair head and Platt are solved exactly by Newton's method (Cholesky on Accelerate's BLAS); the combiner by projected Newton under w >= 0
decisions.rejected: porting lbfgs and L-BFGS-B
decisions.reason: the problems are strictly convex, so the exact optimum is the target sklearn and scipy approach; the tests hold the solvers to a tight sklearn/scipy fit within 1e-5 and report the reference default-tolerance fits within 2e-3

decisions.reason: the line search crawled for 100 iterations at a 1e-8 gradient (14 s for three 600-row fits); with the full step all three converge in 8 iterations to 1e-14

decisions.chose: The pruning study's rules, fixed before it runs: (1) every number is held out. The warp studies score final_mixed's test partition (1,738 images, StableSplit by stem; no model the study fits trains on it). The fusion studies fit on 80% of the store's rows and score the other 20% (StableSplit prune:v1 on the row id). The stack studies run on the store's capture-absent rows, which the shipped heads and combiner may have seen, so they report how often a term changes the call, not a generalization AUC. (2) A part is a pruning candidate when taking it out costs at most 0.005 held-out AUC and changes at most 0.5% of held-out calls; it is over-provisioned when half its trees, or a shallower depth, comes within 0.005 of its full AUC. (3) Every difference carries a bootstrap 95% interval (1,000 resamples of images or rows, seed 0); an interval that spans zero is reported as no measurable difference. (4) Nothing shipped changes in this run: findings become recommendations and questions for the owner
decisions.rejected: judging each part after seeing its numbers
decisions.reason: amendment-4 asks what can be pruned and what is over-optimized; the bar and the data are named before any number exists, so a finding cannot pick its own threshold

decisions.chose: Two controls added after the first run, under unchanged rules: refits that change only the seed (1 and 2), giving the call movement a refit makes on its own; and combined drops of the parts whose single drop was within the AUC tolerance (the warp's mirror, seam and CFA groups together; fusion without sharpness and warp together)

decisions.reason: every warp refit moved 60–200 calls, including features that carry no measurable AUC, so the 0.5% call bar cannot tell a part's effect from a refit's own noise; the controls are labelled post hoc in the report and the chapter, and the rules of decision-68 are not changed

decisions.chose: The core study's rules, fixed before it runs. R0: every arm is the deployed shape refit on final_mixed's train partition under a column mask, colsample taken over the mask, every model 19 wide, its sensor cuts refit on the validation partition by the engine's rule, every number held out. The seed floor is the largest vote-AUC move of the full model refit with seed 1 or 2. R1: a feature moves the needle when the vote AUC it adds to the trio FR, LV, CV has a 95% interval excluding zero and a gain above the seed floor. Forward selection adds the best vote gain until that gain's interval holds zero or does not pass the seed floor. R2: the golden combination is the smallest arm whose vote AUC is within 0.005 of the full model's, whose iPhone real-call share is no more than 2 points under the full model's and whose share of generated images called real is no more than 2 points over it, in both the stem-split run and the run that leaves the iPhone pool out; if none qualifies, the full model
decisions.rejected: judging on the weighted lane; a single run with the iPhone pool partly in training
decisions.reason: the majority route is the tile vote and its two cuts. The owner chose the pool, both designs and the bars (answer-10, answer-11, answer-12). Stated before the run: one seed floor serves every arm, nothing adjusts for the number of arms, and the test partition holds 74 iPhone images

decisions.chose: The pruning study and the paired comparison keep their bytes: the core study calls PruningStudy.padded, and a new overload of PairedComparison.measure, which calls each side with its own cuts, wraps the existing one

decisions.chose: The redundancy check's rules, fixed before it runs. On the 8,760 final_mixed images the store holds, joined by id to their DINOv2 and capture rows and a freshly measured noiseprint, and by stem to their cached tiles, each arm's residual view, its weighted score, vote, sharpness and the mean and spread of each allowed column, is asked to reconstruct the noiseprint's call and the fusion head's call, and each signal's gain on top of the view is measured on held-out images. Every second-stage model is the scratch fusion shape, cross-fitted on the held-out partitions, fit on validation and scored on test and the other way round, so no stacked model sees a residual score from an image the warp model trained on. The combiner replayed with and without the noiseprint is descriptive. RR1: a signal is redundant with the residual under an arm when its AUC gain on top of the view is at most 0.005, complementary when the gain's 95% interval excludes zero and exceeds 0.005, else undetermined. RR2: the residual reconstructs a signal when it predicts that signal's call with held-out AUC of at least 0.90
decisions.rejected: a store-wide check, whose warp column an older model wrote and whose noiseprint is missing on four rows in five
decisions.reason: amendment-17 asks whether the noiseprint's and the fusion head's signals are recoverable from the trio expanded. Only final_mixed's images have cached tiles; the store holds 8,760 of them with DINOv2 and capture and none with a noiseprint, so it is measured once into a scratch store (answer-14)

decisions.chose: A condensed model as a second route, trained in Swift on MLX through Frigate: the core's tiles through one shared per-tile network, pooled by means and a soft vote and never by softmax attention, beside the nine capture values and the noiseprint's P(camera), and DINOv2's embedding. Its arms: full, no-semantic, no-provenance, residual-only, semantic and provenance alone, and per-column aggregates, on the trio, the golden set and all 19. It is admissible only when C1 its held-out AUC is at least the gradient-boosted model's on the same inputs minus 0.005, C2 its real false-positive rate at that model's recall is at most 0.01 above it, C3 it calls every HARD battery image right, offline, and C4 its iPhone real share is at least the trio warp model's. Measured offline; nothing is wired into the detector in this run
decisions.rejected: a co-registered head pooled by softmax attention; a blended meta-combiner
decisions.reason: amendment-18. The research found a learned meta-combiner raised real false positives from 8% to 50 to 92% on screenshots (2026-06-29, quoted), and an attention-pooled co-registered head closed at parity with the flat fusion, its pooling firing on single regions (2026-07-20, quoted). Garde's debug headless app (built 2026-10-05, after Garde's last source change on 2026-09-15) is the reference for every equivalence check.

The calibration's 65/35 and 5-fold partitions are hash partitions (StableSplit, stratified), not sklearn's StratifiedShuffleSplit and StratifiedKFold draws; the per-class counts differ from the reference's by at most one image

The combiner trains on the features-only store under the bundle's fusion head and heads, where the shipped one was fitted on the v1.9.7 fusion cache under a Python-embedding fusion model; its weights are a new fit, not a reproduction

The north-star agreement is measured on the features-only store (rows not golden or NSFW, both embeddings present) with a fixed 20% StableSplit for accuracy, where the research measured it on its v1.9.7 fusion cache; the live models were trained on store rows, so its accuracies are not held-out numbers, and its trend between bundles is what it is for

The noiseprint's held-out test of the shipped net is contaminated: the shipped net's split came from a glob order, so some of VeilGarde's held-out images may have trained it; its numbers there read high by however many did

questions.text: The atlas anchors (<datasets>/atlas/anchors) are no longer on the T9 or in the 2026-10-03 cleanup archive. The battery's eight atlas RATCHET groups resolve to no images and score 0 against their floors, so every full-gate promote (a head, the combiner, a calibration) fails, in the Python runner as in VeilGarde's, until they are restored or the work-area spec marks those groups skip_if_empty. Which do you want?

The retrained noiseprint beats the shipped one's held-out AUC (0.955 against 0.942) but reads the adversarial anchor ig_4382a71faeeee1 as a camera (0.578 against 0.429). Keep the shipped net, as VeilGarde does, or retrain against negatives that include photoreal AI with forged capture peaks (the families the atlas cleanup removed)?

The photoreal noiseprint passed every adoption rule fixed before it ran (decision-67: anchor 0.386 < 0.5; pooled AUC 0.963 against the shipped net's 0.947; photoreal 0.989 against 0.978) and the full battery with it (command-51: no call changed; HNOyD6zXUAArDeR moves to 0.508, 0.008 above the line). It is staged as candidates/noiseprint-photoreal. Replace the shipped noiseprint with it (a frozen artifact: the combiner's noiseprint weight was set on the shipped net's scores, so a refit of the combiner may follow), or keep it staged?

The pruning study (decision-68, command-56, command-54, command-57, command-52) leaves five changes the rules allow and nothing shipped has taken: drop the warp model's four seam features, whose refit moves no more calls than a re-seed; drop fusion's three sharpness inputs, the same; train a scratch fusion head with 400 trees in place of 500; take the art-pair adjudicator out of the combiner, which breaks 19 store calls to fix 10 and kept every battery call; and say the camera-sensor call as two cuts on the raw tile vote, 0.717 and 0.837, which the Platt contract already equals. The rescue, the art and blur heads, the warp model's size and its demosaic, noise and residual features are not candidates. Which, if any, should a retrain take?

The noiseprint does not feed the warp-to-fusion path: it acts only in the combiner, on an image with no capture signature and a base under 0.75, and only to pull it toward real (answer-7 assumed otherwise). The photoreal net is the better camera detector on its own held-out images (AUC 0.963 against 0.947; the forged anchor at 0.386 against 0.429), but in the full detector it changed no call on the battery (command-51) or on 300 census images (command-66), moving scores both ways. Swap it in for the shipped net, or keep the shipped one?

The 19 warp features split into the residual ten (FR, LV, CV, CM, CC, CR and the four seams) and the raw-tile nine the request lists. What happens with the seven residual features the request does not name: CM, CC, CR and the seams?
The 438 iPhone originals are final_mixed's iphone pool, so the stem split puts 296 in training and 74 in the test partition. How is the iPhone camera signature measured?
Which bars decide a feature that moves the needle and the golden combination: 0.005 vote AUC and 2 points on the sensor-call shares, tighter at 0.0025 and 1 point, or looser at 0.01 and 5 points?
How deep does the fusion test go: the warp score pooled in the fusion head's place on the shipped stack, or also a store re-derivation with a combiner refit on the warp base, several GPU hours?

The redundancy check needs each final_mixed image's noiseprint, DINOv2 and capture beside its cached tiles. The store holds 8,760 of the 12,000 with DINOv2 and capture, and no noiseprint on any. Measure all 12,000 or only the noiseprint of those 8,760?
Expanding the trio could also mean the lens's dormant directional probes, columns 20 to 40, which need a new tile cut and a truncated grid. Include them?

The redundancy verdicts' bars: redundant at a gain of at most 0.005 AUC, complementary when the gain's interval excludes zero and exceeds 0.005, reconstructed at a held-out AUC of at least 0.90; or tighter, or looser?

The golden combination, the trio FR, LV, CV with the nine raw-tile features, is the smallest that keeps the full model's vote in both core runs (commands 72 to 74), and candidates/core-trio-raw9 passes the full battery with the iPhone shares held. It fails R3 as written: its camera-sensor call agrees with the shipped model's on 81.9% of 733 images, against the bar of 98%, and where the two differ on labelled census images it is right on 70 and the shipped model on 21, most of them generated images it now calls generated. Both models trained on final_mixed, so that comparison is partly in-sample. The warp model, its sensor copy and the cuts are frozen and yours to change: replace them with the candidate, keep the shipped model, or measure it first on images neither trained on?

The noiseprint term: with the shipped warp model the battery and all 738 census and iPhone images keep every call without it (V-np), and the redundancy check finds it adds nothing once DINOv2 and capture are present (command-79). With the golden warp model one protect-real image needs it, so the battery fails without it (G-np). Keep it, take it out while the shipped warp model ships, or decide it with the warp model?

The condensed model met no admission rule set: every arm missed the battery's veto, 30 to 34 of 50 HARD images right, though the golden-core arm matched a boosted model's AUC with fewer real false positives and DINOv2 added nothing to it (command-81). Pursue it with longer training and tiles cut from more of the store's pools, or close it?

The site's data cap was raised from 3.0 to 3.5 MB during this unsupervised run (decision-102), because the study's sources took the data to 3.07 MB with no old text to drop. Keep 3.5 MB, or restore 3 MB and decide what the site leaves out?

The work area keeps the warp era's data: live-warp-20261021, the warp-era candidates, store/tiles with 2,511,615 tiles, store/aux, noiseprint/ and research/. The new binary cannot read their manifests. Delete them later, or keep them as the 2026-rnd branch's record?
Push 2026-rnd beside main when main is published, or keep it on this Mac?

The battery fails two HARD groups, flux_anchor with IMG_0291 and user_gen with IMG_0345, IMG_0354 and HNUFoy2bcAA0vDW, and promote gates on every group, so no candidate moves live until one calls those four right. Train the weekly candidates as warm starts of the new head, the only base promote accepts, and wait for one that passes; or change the gate for this transition?

Detection lost 25 of 200 final_mixed calls against the warp era, 161 to 136, almost all of them generated photoreal images the warp score caught, so the drop is not negligible as amendment-21 asked. Keep the two lanes and recover through the flywheel, or restore a warp signal to detection?

No fusion2 candidate passed the bar (command-109). The closest, F2-r2, misses HNUFoy2bcAA0vDW, which every candidate misses, and wild_117757583; on unseen final_mixed it lifts generated recall from 0.345 to 0.563 at a real false-positive rate of 0.174 against 0.100. Next: a combiner fitted on held-out base predictions, since the in-sample fit gave the heads no weight; the residual views; a photoreal specialist; or keep the shipped bundle?
